schemes.scheme_name_verbatim: Summary of ICMJE-Based Criteria Used to Evaluate AI Policy in Scientific Journals

dimensions.definition_quote: This table outlines the key domains assessed when reviewing AI-related policies in scientific journals.
value_list_verbatim: Disclosure of AI Usage at Submission
Description of AI Usage in Cover Letter, Acknowledgment Section, or Methods
Human Responsibility for Accuracy and Originality
Review and Editing of AI-generated content
Assertion of No Plagiarism, Including AI Content
dimensions.quote: Criteria were adapted from the International Committee of Medical Journal Editors (ICMJE) recommendations and include requirements for disclosure of AI use

value_list_verbatim: Do not build policy around prohibitions you cannot verify
dimensions.quote: Six principles follow, offered less as rules than as a framework for examining our institutional reflexes before they harden into policy

schemes.scheme_name_verbatim: A Taxonomy of Generative AI Advertising

dimensions.definition_quote: These tiers correspond to interventions on progressively more latent variables in the generative process
dimensions.locator: 3 A Taxonomy of Generative AI Advertising
dimensions.quote: A taxonomy of generative AI advertising organized by influence tier: product mentions (Tier 1), content framing (Tier 2), behavioral redirection (Tier 3)
